title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in thethemefoundry…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in thethemefoundry Make theme versions up to 1.10.10. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can lead to execution of malicious scripts in the context of a user's browser.
